selection_note: Ninth full five-source screening intake after all 40 earlier candidates have received bounded technical dispositions. Fix the same included S1=A Index commit, first-party Python candidates not used in any of the previous eight batches, and reviewed refs, in nonincreasing date order (one 2026-10-19 and four 2026-10-18). These are unproven code-inspection questions; check actual license, first-party path and fit independently. Only native deterministic script/function tests are permitted; exclude live LLM agents, recorded/mocked model behavior, hosted evaluation and provider calls. Human retains external upstream publication rights.

candidates.finding: AgentFlow ships first-party declarative task-graph specs, ready-node selection, persisted status and result-schema logic. Screen deterministic Python validation and dependency/retry bookkeeping using fixed local data, excluding model CLI invocations or mocked model task runs.

ConnectOnion has a first-party Python tool executor and optional approval plugin. Screen native approval, request validation and tool admission helpers with deterministic inputs only; no packaged co ai instance, LLM replies, subagent task or shell/browser side effect.

agentUniverse owns Python agent templates, workflow metadata and configured state/step transitions. Screen exact first-party non-model schema and admission functions through offline script cases, not its ReAct inference loop, multi-agent framework execution or model evaluations.

BESSER's first-party Python runtime includes declarative intent/state transitions and session persistence. Screen deterministic transition and structured input validation without starting the reasoning_body LLM, A2A peer, model provider or interactive app.

BabyAI ships first-party Python task/mission and evaluation configuration around its learner. Screen static input and result-log validation or parser integrity if such script-only first-party behavior exists; do not execute environments, RL episodes, learned agents or imitation/model evaluation.
